description: Assigns the two pedal jacks on the Eagan Matrix instrument and brings the pedal positions back into the patch as control voltage; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Chooses what that pedal jack on the instrument is assigned to: sustain, a sostenuto, a macro, a recirculator parameter, octave switch, fine tune, audio in, pre-level, post-level, or a raw control code
Shows the lowest value the instrument takes from that pedal; turning it sends nothing and the reading comes back when a preset loads, despite the manual saying it chooses the minimum
Shows the highest value the instrument takes from that pedal; turning it sends nothing and the reading comes back when a preset loads, despite the manual saying it chooses the maximum
Sets the interval an octave-switch pedal moves by, in semitones or whole octaves either side of centre
Chooses how an octave-switch pedal behaves: Switch, Toggle or Instant
Turns on the instrument's Preserve Pedals setting, which keeps the pedal assignments made here when a preset is loaded

outputs.text: The position of that pedal on the instrument, 0-10V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
to use a pedal for control voltage alone without changing the sound, assign it to Audio in on an instrument with no AES audio input, or to a macro the preset makes no use of
